items.raw_excerpt: There are few things more irritating than the slow process of recovering from an illness or injury, except, obviously, not recovering at all.

items.raw_excerpt: Some of Prince Edward Island’s oldest cemeteries are increasingly at risk as coastal erosion eats away at the land beneath burial grounds that date back more than two centuries.

items.raw_excerpt: The online platform enables farmers to apply for authorisation to vaccinate their own animals
items.summary_en: South Africa has launched a new online platform that lets livestock farmers apply for permission to vaccinate their own animals against foot-and-mouth disease. The portal aims to speed up the vaccination process and help farmers protect their herds more quickly. The government hopes this self-service approach will reduce the impact of future outbreaks.
